title: Vibrant Spicy Mediterranean Lamb Kebabs
description: Spicy lamb kebabs featuring red wine jelly and agemono-deep-fry, perfect for a keto-friendly dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube
Heat about 2-3 inches of olive oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit
Deep-fry the lamb kebabs for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned
Transfer the kebabs to a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes, or until cooked through
While the kebabs are baking, melt the red wine jelly in a small saucepan over low heat
Brush the melted red wine jelly onto the kebabs during the last 2 minutes of baking
